title: DHE dynamic rare-ID private fallback
hypothesis: On a temporal MovieLens-100K audit, adding a learned rare-item Givens View coordinate plus rank-1 private residual to a deterministic multi-hash model improves rare-item AUC by >=0.01 over a byte-near rank-2 ordinary residual control, while overall AUC drops <=0.003, logloss increases <=0.01, serialized bytes stay <=80% of a full item table, and P95 lookup latency stays <=1.2x native DHE.
physical_object: Shared deterministic multi-hash item embedding decoder plus common user embedding table
mirror_coordinate: One learned Givens angle m_i per train-rare item, acting on a learned shared 2D output plane
logical_multiplicity: Item-specific logical views for IDs with 1-5 training interactions

draw.candidate_rule: registry priority=P0 and status=UNTESTED; exclude IDs with live origin/research/ma-* branches or existing experiments/mirror_applications/ma-* directories

data.split: global timestamp order; first 70% train, next 10% development, final 20% fresh audit
data.tail_definition: computed from training interactions only: rare 1-5, cold 0, common >=6

dhe_style.hash: deterministic BLAKE2b-64 with four fixed seeds

model.mirror: orthonormal 32x2 shared output plane plus one per-rare-item Givens angle
model.private_residual: candidate shared rank-1 basis and one coefficient per rare item; separate rank-2 ordinary residual and full 32D rare-item residual controls

controls: Full learned item table upper control
Deterministic multi-hash DHE-style shared decoder, no item codes
DHE plus per-rare-item Givens Mirror angle only
DHE plus ordinary rank-2 additive residual for train-rare IDs
DHE plus Mirror angle and rank-1 private residual for train-rare IDs
DHE plus full private residual for train-rare IDs (frequency-truncated lookup control)

fresh.audit_access: only after all model checkpoints are selected using development data

metrics: binary logloss and ROC-AUC on train-rare, cold, and common item audit strata
actual safetensors inference payload bytes including all state and rare-ID mapping
active MAC proxy, adapter/decode operations, CPU examples/s and P95 batch-1 latency
training updates, tokens/events seen, train and wall-clock

storage.format: safetensors plus metadata embedded in its header

success_gate: Mean rare-item AUC gain >=0.01 vs rank-2 residual control, positive in >=2/3 seeds; overall AUC drop <=0.003; logloss increase <=0.01; actual payload <=80% full table; P95 <=1.2x DHE; not dominated by byte-near ordinary residual control.
boundaries: The DHE-style implementation is not the optimized paper kernel.
Fixed budget or one dataset is not a general capacity claim.
A Mirror-specific claim requires the matched ordinary rank-2 residual control.
